hold_text: W6-PROP-FEED: a new systemd timer on the live VM (deploy/ict-prop-feed.timer) that LOGS IN to the live breakout_1 prop account every 5 min and writes account_status rows through POST /api/bot/prop/report. install_systemd_units.sh auto-enables every deploy/*.timer, so merging IS enabling. Held for two reasons: (1) the dispatch declares it Tier-2 with a landing hold, and the manager reviews independently before merge; (2) the concurrent-session question is unresolved. Breakout's served DXtrade client carries session_expired_popup.message.force_logout='You have logged in somewhere else' (measured by curl, 2026-09-28). Whether one session per user is enforced is NOT measured, and if it is, every tick logs the operator's manual terminal out. Deliberately NOT armed: an automerge-request file would land it.
why: 5-min read-only breakout_1 account_status feed: a new VM oneshot timer + wrapper (flock, hard timeout, trip-on-failure backoff) around the existing read-only breakout_login_check.py; the action gains a shared lock + apply: reset-feed. No order path, no strategy/risk/config change.
